title: Show the displayed QQ16 output is one quarter-turn of the source formula
body:
## Summary
- `i · (s − i d) / 2 = (d + i s) / 2`, so the displayed second output is one quarter-turn of the pinned source formula. Component magnitudes are unchanged.
- Each of 11,076 axis factors pays `4 + 2 + 4 = 10` real operations, so the lambda coefficient is `11076 · 10 = 110760`. The lambda-one total satisfies `483082 − 110760 = 372322`.
- Cover transfers are `528 · 4 = 2112` per `N`, and storage is `712 · 2 + 2 = 1426` words of scale `N`, plus 12 scalar words. Partial result. No new kappa and no selected-frontier change.
